instruction: Select all images containing a chair.

game.semantic_variant: Select all things made for sitting on.
game.hint: Select all that apply. If you are unsure, use your best judgement.
game.explanation: Ordinary chairs count, and so does the office chair on crab legs: impossible, but still a chair. The person wearing a strapped-on chair seat, the tree stump carved into a seat and the toilet with an armchair's back and arms are borderline cases, recorded without a verdict. The floor lamp, the chest of drawers and the clothes rail are not chairs.

correct: Correct. The Department has taken a seat to celebrate.
partial: Partially correct. Some chairs remain standing.
Partially correct. A chair has been left unattended.
incorrect: Incorrect. No policy currently exists for this kind of seating.
Incorrect. The chairs have been asked to stand down.

selection_review.reason: Version 2 of C02, adding the re-rendered toilet armchair so that all three borderline concepts of the chairs pool appear. Nine distinct, standardised images reviewed together at tile size: two ordinary chairs (weathered wooden spindle-back chair; pink metal folding chair against a green wall), one impossible chair (generated black office chair on red crab legs), three borderline seats (generated person on all fours wearing a chair seat and backrest; photographed tree stump carved into a high-backed seat; generated toilet with a green velvet backrest and armrests) and three non-members (floor lamp, sage-green chest of drawers, clothes rail). Generated images appear among targets and borderline cases alike; views, colours and settings vary within each role. The reading armchair and the walking chair remain in the collection.
